T18 (D38): extend the imported WebRTC owner with the signaling/ICE state machine, transceiver list, ice-candidate precondition and data-channel send accounting the RTCPeerConnection adapter drives. The donor header had no signaling transitions (states only changed on close), so ruyijs promotes the aggregate that owns peer/data-channel state to also own the signalling table.

T19 (D39): extend the imported WebGPU capability owner with the GPUSupportedLimits table the donor header lacked, so the adapter reads every limit from this owner instead of writing a literal.
